items.title: CoStar Group (CSGP) Recasts Homes.com Leadership After Profit Milestone While Valuation Debate Builds
items.summary: CoStar Group (CSGP) has put a fresh leadership piece in place, naming portal veteran Felix Kusch president of Homes.com after the unit delivered its first profitable quarter and 66% year-over-year revenue growth. Investors have seen mixed signals around CoStar Group recently, with the 7-day share price return of 4.0% contrasting with a year-to-date share price decline of 52% and a 1-year total shareholder return down 64%. items.title: CoStar Group (CSGP) Stock Looks Fairly Valued After A Sharp Reset
items.summary: CoStar Group has seen a steep reset in its share price, and the question now is whether the current US$31.52 level can be squared with what the business is generating in sales. For a stock that has long traded on expectations around digital real estate data and marketplaces, the link between its revenue base and today’s valuation matters more than ever. items.title: Is CoStar Group Stock Underperforming the S&P 500?

items.title: 2 Services Stocks with Promising Prospects and 1 We Ignore
items.summary: Business services providers play a critical role for enterprises, assisting them with everything from new hardware integrations to consulting and marketing. Furthermore, the demand for their offerings is rising as more clients outsource non-core functions, a trend that has enabled the industry to return 19.8% over the past six months. At the same time, the S&P 500 was up 11.7%.

items.title: 3 CEOs Are Buying Millions of Dollars of Their Beaten-Down Stocks

items.title: 3 Reasons CSGP is Risky and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
items.summary: Shareholders of CoStar would probably like to forget the past six months even happened. The stock dropped 28.5% and now trades at $32.29. This was partly due to its softer quarterly results and might have investors contemplating their next move.
